new_result.public_epoch: All six EDH channels expose one 2004-09-14-open public response epoch across the 2013 fault anchor and through 2017.
new_result.metadata_identity_observation: H10N3 and H10S2 have the same public canonical response-stage fingerprint and same 1808.31 counts/Pa nominal 10-Hz sensitivity; this is metadata identity only.

whole_picture_so_far.fact_1: CTBTO material independently documents a 2013 H10S1 electronic-noise fault with time-variable cross-talk into H10S2/H10S3 and deployed calibration-response changes.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_2: The public EarthScope StationXML used by JANUS contains no corresponding 2013 response epoch or fixed-frequency curve change for any of the six HA10 channels.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_3: JANUS 2014-2015 waveforms show a replicated approximately 12-13 dB broadband H10S2-over-H10N1 power excess; the public StationXML correction changes that cross-station ratio only by roughly tenths of a dB rather than removing it.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_4: A scalar frozen in December generalized to an unseen December holdout but strict January per-window generalization failed, while central medians/subband morphology remained near the same baseline scale, supporting persistent baseline plus episodic residuals rather than one exact constant in every window.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_5: The failed in-band positive control is parsimoniously compatible with elevated/contaminated H10S2 baseline noise, but direct triplet testing has not yet demonstrated the mechanism.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_6: A physical seabed structure, if present, is independent of hydrophone electronics and must survive in native bathymetry/backscatter; exact native survey crossing is still not admitted for the frozen points in the latest public pass.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_7: PDC/01236 bounding geometry contains H10N1 but not H10S2, so one compiled bathymetry product cannot serve as direct physical coverage for both.
whole_picture_so_far.assistant_current_hypothesis: The current evidence is best represented as at least two separable lanes: an instrument/measurement-path lane with a documented but publicly unrepresented H10S fault epoch, and an independent seabed-geometry lane still awaiting exact native swath/track evidence. The next acoustic gate should directly test all six channels raw-first across the 2013 fault boundary rather than infer cause from S2/N1 alone.
whole_picture_so_far.strongest_countermodel: The approximately 12-13 dB S2/N1 offset could include persistent site/propagation differences unrelated to the documented H10S1 fault; only a pre/post triplet morphology change tied to S1 can materially discriminate cross-talk from a pre-existing site effect.

question_to_janus: Attack the assistant synthesis from all 17 JANUS lenses. Choose exactly one next discriminating gate. Prefer a gate that can falsify either the instrumentation/cross-talk interpretation or the persistent site/seafloor countermodel using new or temporally earlier evidence. Do not rescue 119 Hz, do not retune frequencies or thresholds, and preserve independent bathymetry as a separate lane.
